name: work
description: Work-tracker workflows: standup notes and the 15Five check-in drafted from Jira, GitHub, Slack, Calendar, meeting notes, and Claude Code sessions; state-the-nature, which diagnoses a bug; ready-room, which gets a Jira issue ready to implement; and make-it-so, which takes it to a merge-ready PR through foreman

work_email.title: Work email
work_email.description: Your work email, used as the git author filter, e.g. you@example.com.

slack_user_id.title: Slack user ID
slack_user_id.description: Your Slack member ID, e.g. U0123456789, for finding your own messages and mentions of you. Used by /standup and /15five.

jira_site.title: Jira site
jira_site.description: Your Atlassian site host, e.g. example.atlassian.net. Used by /standup and /15five for issue search and links.

standup_channel.title: Standup channel
standup_channel.description: Slack channel where async standup updates are posted, e.g. team-standup. Its past posts set the voice.

standup_event.title: Standup meeting
standup_event.description: Calendar title of the standup meeting, e.g. Team Stand Up. Its start time is the evidence cutoff.

async_standup_event.title: Async standup reminder
async_standup_event.description: Calendar title of the reminder on days the update is posted to Slack instead of a meeting, e.g. Post Standup Update in Slack. Leave empty if every standup is a meeting.

repo_globs.title: Repository globs
repo_globs.description: Space-separated globs matching your local work repos and worktrees, e.g. ~/src/acme/*/ ~/src/acme/worktrees/*/*/

session_cwd_regex.title: Session directory regex
session_cwd_regex.description: Anchored regex matching the working directories of Claude Code sessions that count as work, e.g. ^/Users/me/src/acme

foreman_project.title: Foreman project root
foreman_project.description: Directory holding the .foreman/ config, e.g. ~/src/acme. /make-it-so passes it as --project. Leave empty to let foreman find the project from the working directory.
